name: NAVER Corporation
summary: NAVER Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides online search portal and information services in South Korea and internationally. It is involved in the electronic financial; film and audio content production and distribution; Webtoon service development and operation; language learning application development; monitoring and advertisement operation; mobile service operation; trading platform operation; clothes, accessories, and news distribution; web novel platform support; and e-commerce businesses.
